pt.label: Personal Training
pt.heading: Should I hire a personal trainer?
intro: Hiring a personal trainer is essential. The benefits are remarkable, as they go a long way toward guaranteeing that you reach your health and fitness goals. Some people are initially turned off by hiring a personal trainer when they consider the cost or fear a trainer pushing them too hard.
We support, motivate, and guide you through this transformative journey.
items: Paying close attention to individual training programs and nutrition habits, such as customized programs
Arranging fitness assessments to measure strength and imbalances
Addressing fitness level and desired goals
Unconditional professionalism to help you progress in developing a healthy lifestyle

t4u.label: Time 4 U
t4u.heading: Because lasting change starts when you finally make time for YOU.
t4u.intro: Life is full — but your health doesn't have to take a back seat. The TIME 4 U Online Program is designed for busy men and women who want structure, accountability, and expert coaching — all from the comfort of their own space. No more guessing. No more starting over every Monday.
items: Customized Workouts — Tailored to your goals, fitness level, and schedule
Weekly Check-Ins — Keep your progress on track with personalized feedback
Nutrition Coaching — Learn how to fuel your body without restriction or fad diets
24/6 Access to Your Coach — Support when you need it most
Private WhatsApp Community — Daily encouragement, accountability, and motivation
Monthly Team Zoom Calls — Celebrate wins and focus on topic coaching
Time Management Strategies — Fit fitness into real life, not the other way around
Mindset Coaching — Build lasting habits and break free from the all-or-nothing cycle
Monthly Challenges — To keep you motivated, consistent, and having fun
t4u.note: This isn't a quick fix. It's a proven system to help you show up consistently, rebuild your confidence, and take back your health — one habit at a time.

classes.label: Group Classes
classes.heading: Exceed Your Expectations
classes.specialMsg: All of the classes except for the Boot Camps are at Arbor Greene.

list.name: Full Bodyweight Workout
list.desc: The most effective way to boost your metabolism, burn body fat, and gain strength is with a variety of movements that work the major muscle groups. This class is for all fitness levels.

list.name: Core and More
list.desc: This circuit style class will move you in different directions to improve balance, core stability, posture, fall prevention, and cardiovascular fitness. For all fitness levels.

list.name: Strength and Mobility
list.desc:
Strength & Mobility

Get stronger. Move better. Feel better.

This low-impact, full-body class combines functional strength training with mobility, balance, flexibility, and controlled movement. Participants will work on building strength, improving joint mobility and stability, increasing range of motion, and moving with greater confidence in everyday life.

Classes may include both standing and mat-based exercises, with modifications available for different fitness levels.

All fitness levels welcome.

list.name: Total Body Fit
list.desc: This 60 minute class addresses the fundamentals of all well balanced exercise programs: cardio, muscle strength, flexibility, and body composition.  Each workout is diverse, fun, and engaging.  Never the exact same program twice.

pricing.consultNote: Consult: 1 hour FREE · Over 1 hour: $30 per 30 minutes

tiers.label: Foundation
feats: Perfect for athletes who want a customized training plan, accountability, and expert guidance without needing high-touch coaching.
Adjustments for travel, illness, recovery & schedule changes
Newer triathletes, Sprint/Olympic athletes, or experienced athletes who primarily need personalized structure and accountability.

tiers.label: Performance
feats: More feedback. More analysis. More accountability.
For athletes who want their coach actively involved in their training, fueling, strength, recovery, and race preparation.
Heart rate, pace, cadence & power analysis when applicable
Training periodization around your race calendar
Adjustments based on performance, fatigue & recovery
Video technique analysis at designated intervals
Athletes pursuing PRs, competitive Sprint/Olympic athletes, 70.3 athletes, or athletes who want more than a training plan.

tiers.label: Elite
feats: High-touch coaching. Detailed analysis. Maximum personalization.
For athletes who want their coach highly involved in managing their training and performance throughout the season.
Training reviewed & adjusted as needed throughout the week
Competitive age-group athletes, 70.3/Ironman athletes, PR and podium-focused athletes, championship qualification goals, or athletes wanting the highest level of coaching support.

about.label: About
about.heading: Our passion is to give others their lives back
paragraphs: Heather had a dream of having her own Training business. Her vision is to help clients succeed in their training by providing excellent customer service, passion, and expertise. Our business, JOY Thru Fitness, started six years ago.
We are Traveling Trainers passionate about helping clients of all ages and ethnicities live healthier lifestyles. Our intent behind traveling to you is that convenience is half the battle!
JOY Thru Fitness enjoys training youth to older adults. Our clients enjoy training with us because of our ethics, transparency, knowledge, and passion for helping others.

trainers.label: Trainers
trainers.heading: Knowledge and experience that transforms you into a better self

people.name: Heather Downs
people.bio: Heather's transformation leads to her career as a Personal Trainer and Triathlon Coach. She has been a Personal Trainer for 15 years and a Triathlon Coach for 12 years. Her dedication and passion for helping you achieve your goals shine through in her training.
people.interests: Heather appreciates diversity. She enjoys exploring and traveling to new places.
people.philosophy: You don't get what you wish for; you get what you work for.
people.funfacts: She loves animals, nature, and photography.
certs: NESTA Certified Lifestyle Weight Management Specialist

people.name: Addison Arneson
people.bio: Addison was inspired to become a personal trainer after 12 years of gymnastics, three years of coaching, and teaching swim lessons. Currently pursuing a B.S. in Exercise Science and Kinesiology at USF.
people.interests: Spending time in nature, reading, and exploring new places.
people.philosophy: It's not about perfection; it's about improvement.
people.funfacts: Moved from Minnesota · Once dreamed of being a marine biologist · The beach is her happy place.
certs: American Red Cross Lifeguarding with CPR/AED

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.heading: What some of our clients are saying!

items.q: Before working with JTF, I was at a gym with a Trainer for a year and did not see the results I wanted. I've been working with JTF since December and have already lost 12 pounds and 3½ inches! Heather is great and really takes the time to understand you and your goals.
Heather knows how to encourage, when to push, and when I need a break. If you're looking for a highly qualified, caring, and professional personal trainer, I would highly recommend Heather.

It's never the same routine with Heather — plus, there is always some challenge, which is very exciting. I am glad to have joined her triathlon group — after 8 weeks, my swimming skills have definitely improved.

Great Trainers and very professional! They are so encouraging and provide alternative moves for knee or back concerns. I would definitely recommend JTF for Personal Training and Group Fitness Classes! Week 6, and I am moving and feeling stronger.

I can't recommend Heather highly enough as a Personal Trainer.  She brings a rare combination o fthoughtfulness, organization and professionalism to every session.  What really sets her apart is her holistic approach - she doesn't just focus on building strength, but also emphasizes balance, stability, and the connection between body and mind.

Her workouts are always well-strctured andd intentional, and she takes the time to tailor everything to your individual needs and goals.  YOu can tell she genuinely cares about her clients' progress and overall well-being not jjust the numbers on a weight rack.

If you're looking for a Trainer who will push you while also helping you move better, feel better, and stay consistent, Heather is an outstanding choice.

I love Leighs classes!  I don't feel bored because she constantly changes her routines.  She also gives modifications so there is a simpler version if I can't yet do the harder version one and gives feedback so I use proper form and don't injure myself.  Best of all after 6 months of workking with her 2xs a week I can wear those too-tight pants and I feel great in my body (feel fit? Strong?)

JoyTHRUFitness is a fantastic group that brought more joy and more fitness into our lives as my husband and I started working with Heather for almost 6 months now. It has been definitely more than worth the investment of our time and money. If you are looking to cultivate more heath and fitness in your life, this is group for you. Highly recommend! I do want to note that my husband and I have always worked out together or individually but with Heather’s expertise we have been able to exponentially improve in our fitness, mobility, balance, strength, endurance, and even energy levels. Regardless of your fitness level, working with JoyTRUFitness can be very beneficial for you as they build a program around your goals whether it is to lose weight, get stronger, do a tri, swim, run, bike, etc. JoyTRUFitness trainers are a wealth of information and coaching. Definitely reach out and give them a try.
